phases: Validate pins/containment/budget; publish one-row owned baseline
Generate first complete row beyond64MiB directly to OneDrive and checkpoint bytes/hash

checkpointPolicy: Completed phase evidence and identities persist outside scratch. Any handled failure/cancellation removes all owned generated payloads. If replay is required, rebuild deterministic materialisations only as needed and reuse matching completed check evidence; no resumable payload is claimed after deletion.
